description: Word Error Rate of app.ingestion.vision.ocr_image against data/sample_scanned.pdf, page 1. No ground-truth text file existed anywhere in the repo before this session - it was established by rendering the page and reading it directly, since the fixture was a generated image with no text layer.
ground_truth: Q3 Facilities Report The Austin office lease was renewed for 3 more years. Total facilities spend for the quarter was 95,000 dollars.

before_fix.description: Original 4 runs at the (then-)default temperature=0.2, no line-repetition safeguard. 3/4 clean, 1/4 hit a duplication bug (model restated line 1 verbatim, then continued into a second, garbled attempt).

temperature_0_investigation.description: Hypothesis: the duplication was sampling randomness, fixable by setting temperature=0.0. Tested by rerunning 4 trials at temperature=0.0 with no other change. Result disproved the hypothesis: all 4 runs produced the exact same duplication byte-for-byte - a deterministic model bias, not noise. An added 'do not repeat yourself' prompt instruction also did not stop it. Neither fix worked at the model/prompt level.

after_line_truncation_safeguard.description: app.ingestion.vision._truncate_at_repeated_line() detects an exact repeated non-empty line in the output and truncates from that point on, since every observed failure has everything after the repeat be garbage. This is a mitigation for the observed failure signature, not a fix for why the model duplicates - it would not catch a repeat that isn't an exact line match.
